Certifies for G=D4xC2 (encoded x=a+4b+8e in {0..15}, semidirect mulG): (i) mulG is a group with Z(G)={0,2,8,10}; (ii) A:(r->r^3,s->s,c->r^2c), B:(r->r^3c,s->s,c->c) are genuine automorphisms, both OUTER (band beta!=0); (iii) the commutator [A,B]=A B A^-1 B^-1 is conjugation by s, a NONzero inner (c_s(r)=r^3!=r), with representative set exactly s*Z(G)={4,6,12,14} so [s] is a well-defined class; (iv) NO inner adjustment makes a lift (A c_u, B c_v) commute (brute-forced over all 16x16), and every realized lift-commutator is c_g with g in s*Z(G) -- the same class [s] for all lifts (lift-independence); (v) A,B act trivially on Inn G=G/Z (trivial coefficient action). Together: delta(beta)=[s]!=0 in H^2(T^2;Inn G)=(Z/2)^2. Does NOT formalize the general class-2 Lemma reduction (cup/d2 bookkeeping) -- that stays the elementary math of lifting-delta-commutator-lemma; this is its finite input, verified honestly with [propext] only (two decls axiom-free).

children.approach: Lean 4 certification of the three finite H^2 witness cells (Mathlib-free, core Bool/List/Nat + decide; axioms=[propext], mulD4_is_group needs none). ONE general finite-category reduced-nerve F2 cochain engine (objects + (src,tgt) morphism list + partial composition -> chains n -> face maps d0,d1,d2 -> honest Gaussian rank -> H^n) handles witnesses 1-2: betti_Z2 gives H^{0,1,2}(B(Z/2))=(1,1,1) (H^2=1, minimal nonvanishing class), betti_diamond gives (1,1,0) with 2 nondegenerate 2-simplices present (degree-genuineness: 2-simplices !=> H^2!=0), gerbe_H2_loop_vs_dag states H^2(loop)=1 & H^2(DAG)=0. Witness 3 (d4_central_extension_nonsplit / d4_no_complement_to_centre): D4 central extension non-split via 'every order-4 subgroup contains r^2' (no complement to Z(D4)), with mulD4_is_group + cyclic_r_order4_subgroup as validity/non-vacuity backstops. SCOPE: certifies the finite arithmetic of the three cells ONLY -- NOT the gerbe framework (Thm A rectification<=>vanishing, functoriality, Thm C independence), which are the cited/proved facts. K=D4 only (Q8 and the section-cocycle-coboundary test stay Python-oracle). File lean/2026-10-09-gerbe-h2-witnesses.lean; generalises lean/2026-10-08-nerve-level-separation.lean (monoid bar engine) to multiple objects.
